name: codebert-python
creator: neulab
old_description_hint: CodeBERT language model trained on Python code for masked language modeling. Best at: generating contextual embeddings for Python source code and code evaluation. Domains: software development, code quality, machine learning. Typical uses: code generation evaluation via CodeBERTScore, code similarity assessment, source code analysis. Not suited for: non-Python code or general NLP tasks.

name: legal-bert-base-uncased
creator: nlpaueb
old_description_hint: BERT variant trained on diverse English legal texts including legislation, contracts, and court cases. Best at: legal document classification, contract analysis, statute understanding, and legal NLP tasks. Domains: law, contracts, legislation, legal technology. Typical uses: contract clause classification, legal document categorization, computational law applications. Not suited for: non-English legal systems or general-domain text.

name: Clinical-Longformer
creator: yikuan8
old_description_hint: Longformer variant pre-trained on MIMIC-III clinical notes, supporting up to 4,096 input tokens for long document processing. Best at: NER, question answering, natural language inference, and text classification on extended clinical texts. Domains: clinical healthcare. Typical uses: analysis of long clinical documents, discharge summaries, comprehensive medical record understanding. Not suited for: short-text tasks or general-domain use.

name: nsfw_image_detection
creator: Falconsai
old_description_hint: Fine-tuned Vision Transformer for content moderation. Trained on 80,000 diverse images with binary classification (normal/NSFW). Best at: detecting inappropriate images for content filtering. Domains: social media, user-generated content platforms. Typical uses: photo review pipelines, automated content screening. Not suited for: nuanced aesthetic judgments.

name: vit-base-patch16-224
creator: google
old_description_hint: Vision Transformer model by Google for image classification. Pre-trained on ImageNet-21k and fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k. Best at: 1,000-class image classification at 224x224 resolution. Typical uses: object recognition, image tagging, transfer learning backbone. Not suited for: real-time inference on resource-constrained devices.

name: Weather-Image-Classification
creator: prithivMLmods
old_description_hint: Vision-language classifier fine-tuned from SiglIP for weather condition recognition in images. Best at: identifying weather conditions (sunny, cloudy, rainy, snowy, foggy) from visual data. Domains: computer vision, weather, environmental monitoring. Typical uses: automated weather tagging for media, autonomous vehicle enhancement, smart surveillance systems. Not suited for: weather forecasting or numerical data analysis.

name: mobilenetv3_small_100.lamb_in1k
creator: timm
old_description_hint: MobileNetV3 small (2.5M params) image classifier trained on ImageNet-1k by timm library. Best at: Efficient image classification on mobile and edge devices. Typical uses: Real-time mobile image recognition, embedded vision systems, edge inference. Not suited for: Audio processing, text understanding, high-accuracy requirements.

name: resnet18.a1_in1k
creator: timm
old_description_hint: ResNet-18 architecture trained on ImageNet-1k via timm library. Lightweight 11.7M parameter model for image classification. Best at: efficient 1,000-class image recognition. Typical uses: feature extraction, backbone for downstream tasks, real-time inference. Not suited for: small object detection or pixel-level tasks.

name: Prithvi-WxC-1.0-2300M
creator: ibm-nasa-geospatial
old_description_hint: IBM-NASA 2.3B parameter foundation model for weather and climate trained on MERRA-2 atmospheric data for forecasting and reconstruction. Best at: weather prediction and atmospheric state reconstruction from partial observations. Domains: meteorology, climate modeling. Typical uses: weather forecasting, downscaling, gravity wave parameterization, climate downscaling. Not suited for: long-range seasonal forecasting without adaptation.

name: clipseg-rd64-refined
creator: CIDAS
old_description_hint: CLIPSeg model for zero-shot and one-shot image segmentation. Combines CLIP with segmentation capability. Best at: segmenting objects based on text or image prompts without task-specific training. Typical uses: interactive image editing, visual search, content removal. Not suited for: real-time inference on edge devices.

name: segformer-satellite-segementation
creator: Pranilllllll
old_description_hint: SegFormer-B0 semantic segmentation model fine-tuned on Kathmandu Valley satellite imagery for land-use classification. Best at: classifying pixels into urban and land-cover categories in satellite imagery. Domains: earth observation, urban planning, geospatial analysis. Typical uses: urban planning studies, land-use mapping, geographic analysis. Not suited for: regions outside training area or non-satellite imagery.

name: BiRefNet
creator: ZhengPeng7
old_description_hint: BiRefNet for high-resolution dichotomous image segmentation (salient object detection). Produces binary masks separating foreground from background. Best at: precise object/subject extraction at 1024x1024 resolution. Domains: photography, e-commerce, design. Typical uses: product background removal, portrait extraction. Not suited for: multi-class semantic segmentation.
